chunks: And al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
"The shirt for the deceased should be without cuffs and without buttons."

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.الْقَمِيصُ: the shirt or tunic used for the deceased
key_terms.غَيْرَ مَكْفُوفٍ: without cuffs or folded/hemmed sleeve ends

ai.seo_question: How should the shirt of the deceased be prepared according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the shrouding of the deceased. It states that the shirt prepared for the dead should not be cuffed or buttoned, indicating a specific funerary practice in Islamic jurisprudence.
